where: After Tutorial Part 2, if you chose both tribes

lines.name: Brother Ripple, the otternarian
lines.text: You chose both sides. Brave. Most folk on this river can't manage one.
lines.where: After Tutorial Part 2, if you chose both tribes

lines.name: Brother Ripple, the otternarian
lines.text: Making peace is slower than making war, and twice as tiring. Everyone wants it; nobody wants to go first.
lines.replies: I'll go first. | How can I help?

lines.name: Brother Ripple, the otternarian
lines.text: Win where you can, mend where you can't. And when you meet someone from the other bank, talk before you swing.
lines.label: help

lines.name: Brother Ripple, the otternarian
lines.text: Then I'll need your help. Peace needs friends on both banks, and right now it has one: you.
lines.label: yes

lines.text: Here, take this. A gift from each side, so neither feels left out.
lines.label: end

where: Map curiosity: An empty eyrie (Map 11 Eyrie Heights)

lines.name: Matriarch Aurelia
lines.text: An eyrie, abandoned. The eggs hatched long ago.
lines.where: Map curiosity: An empty eyrie (Map 11 Eyrie Heights)

lines.name: Warlord Vesper
lines.portrait: card art: Crimson Wing Duelist Cadet
lines.text: Wherever they flew, they flew alone. Like all the best ones.

where: Map curiosity: A torn banner (Map 20 The Sundered Peak)

lines.name: High Marshal Shieldback
lines.text: A torn banner on the ridge. Not ours, not theirs.
lines.where: Map curiosity: A torn banner (Map 20 The Sundered Peak)

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: There are more than two sides on this road. You'll meet them.

where: Map curiosity: A signpost (Map 0 Bramblewood Outskirts)

lines.name: Captain Swiftpaw
lines.text: A signpost, and every arm points somewhere we haven't been yet.
lines.where: Map curiosity: A signpost (Map 0 Bramblewood Outskirts)

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Clovermead is the next one along. Want to see where it sits?
lines.replies: Show me the road. [map:mq] | One map at a time.

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Sensible. The road keeps.
lines.label: stay

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: There. Past the briars.
lines.label: go

lines.name: Captain Swiftpaw
lines.text: Someone carved a little otter on the post. Nice work, too.
lines.label: end

where: Map curiosity: A lit lantern (Map 4 Sunken Hollow)

lines.name: Whisper-of-Ash
lines.text: Someone left a lantern burning down here. Nobody is minding it.
lines.where: Map curiosity: A lit lantern (Map 4 Sunken Hollow)

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: In the Hollow, a lit lantern means “I'll be back”. It's bad luck to blow it out.
lines.replies: Leave it lit. | Trim the wick.

lines.name: Whisper-of-Ash
lines.text: …It burns brighter. That's either very good or very bad.
lines.label: trim

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Good. Somebody's coming home.
lines.label: lit

lines.name: Whisper-of-Ash
lines.text: I'll keep an eye on it. I keep an eye on everything.
lines.label: end

where: Map curiosity: A black cairn (Map 19 Ashen Spurn)

lines.name: Matriarch Aurelia
lines.text: A cairn of black stones. Each one, a climber who didn't come down.
lines.where: Map curiosity: A black cairn (Map 19 Ashen Spurn)

lines.name: High Marshal Shieldback
lines.text: Add a stone for them. Then keep climbing.

where: Map curiosity: Old Cinder's stall (Map 19 Ashen Spurn)

lines.name: Old Cinder, the Ember Peddler
lines.text: Warm cinders, cold cards, everything in between. The Shop has my good stock.
lines.replies: Take me to the Shop. [tab:shop] | Just browsing the mountain.
lines.where: Map curiosity: Old Cinder's stall (Map 19 Ashen Spurn)

lines.text: Browse away. The mountain charges nothing. Yet.
lines.label: no

lines.text: Mind the step. It's hot.
lines.label: go

lines.name: Old Cinder, the Ember Peddler
lines.text: Come back when the ash settles.
lines.label: end

lines.name: Captain Swiftpaw
lines.text: HELLO!
lines.where: Map curiosity: An echoing hollow (Map 8 Caves & Alcoves)

lines.name: Whisper-of-Ash
lines.text: …hello… hello… hello…

lines.name: Captain Swiftpaw
lines.text: That last one wasn't the echo.

where: Map curiosity: A glowworm pool (Map 8 Caves & Alcoves)

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Glowworms over still water. They light the cave a little brighter for every map you clear down here.
lines.where: Map curiosity: A glowworm pool (Map 8 Caves & Alcoves)

lines.name: Whisper-of-Ash
lines.text: Clear the caves and the dark gets kinder. Your lantern too.

where: Map curiosity: The old baobab (Map 14 Savanna Reaches)

lines.where: Map curiosity: The old baobab (Map 14 Savanna Reaches)

lines.name: Matriarch Aurelia
lines.text: Even rivals share shade out here. Remember that when the sun is high.

where: Map curiosity: A drum by the waterhole (Map 14 Savanna Reaches)

lines.label: go

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: The savanna will ask again.
lines.label: no

lines.text: Out here, everybody hears the drum.
lines.label: end

lines.name: High Marshal Shieldback
lines.text: An ice-fishing hole, and a line still in it.
lines.where: Map curiosity: An ice-fishing hole (Map 17 Wolfsbane Tundra)

lines.name: Captain Swiftpaw
lines.text: Whoever left it is coming back cold and hungry.

where: Map curiosity: A spiral shell (Map 10 Coral Current)

lines.text: A great spiral shell. Hold it up and you hear the reef breathing.
lines.where: Map curiosity: A spiral shell (Map 10 Coral Current)

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Flood… ebb… flood. The tide decides who hits harder. Watch the pill on the field.
lines.label: go

lines.text: The reef will still be breathing later.
lines.label: no

lines.name: Matriarch Aurelia
lines.text: Tide units ride the Flood. Keep that in mind.
lines.label: end

where: Map curiosity: A coral wreck (Map 10 Coral Current)

lines.where: Map curiosity: A coral wreck (Map 10 Coral Current)

where: Map curiosity: A light over the bog (Map 6 Sable Swampmire)

lines.name: Whisper-of-Ash
lines.text: A light over the bog. Don't follow it.
lines.where: Map curiosity: A light over the bog (Map 6 Sable Swampmire)

lines.name: Captain Swiftpaw
lines.text: I wasn't going to. …Much.

where: Map curiosity: The old anvil (Map 19 Basalt Foundry)

lines.where: Map curiosity: The old anvil (Map 19 Basalt Foundry)

lines.label: go

lines.label: no

lines.text: The gulls will read it anyway. Gulls read everything.
lines.label: leave

lines.where: Map curiosity: A humming stump (Map 1 Thistlewood)

lines.text: The Arena. Strangers, tickets, bad manners.

lines.name: Warlord Vesper
lines.portrait: card art: Crimson Wing Duelist Cadet
lines.text: Of course. Later. They always say later.

lines.text: It is in your Codex now, under Maps.

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: The Flea Market. Buy from other players, sell what you don't need. Haggling is frowned upon. Mostly.

lines.text: An old nest. Somebody kept their cards here once.
lines.where: Map feature: Nest (Map 3 Gannet Cliffs)

lines.text: Everything you win ends up in yours now. Want a look?

lines.name: High Marshal Shieldback
lines.text: Count it twice. Soldiers lose things.
lines.label: go

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Notice how the cards fall into families? Otters, badgers and moles are all Beasts. Bees and scorpions are Arthropods.
lines.where: Opening the Codex once card families (phyla) unlock  · arena_app.js:6018

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Those families are phyla. The Codex can sort and filter by them now.

where: Map feature: Quest Board (Map 8 Caves & Alcoves)

lines.name: High Marshal Shieldback
lines.text: A proper quest board. Real requests from real folk, not lodge orders.
lines.where: Map feature: Quest Board (Map 8 Caves & Alcoves)

lines.name: Captain Swiftpaw
lines.text: So when somebody on the road says “could you…”, it goes up here?

lines.name: High Marshal Shieldback
lines.text: Errands. Small favours, small rewards. They add up.
lines.label: go

where: Map feature: Notices (Map 4 Sunken Hollow)

lines.name: High Marshal Shieldback
lines.text: The notice board. Orders from the lodge — every day, every week.
lines.where: Map feature: Notices (Map 4 Sunken Hollow)

lines.name: Captain Swiftpaw
lines.text: The first few pay well. The rest… pay.

lines.name: High Marshal Shieldback
lines.text: Do the work, get the leaves. That's the whole system.
lines.label: go

where: Map feature: Raid Banner (Map 13 The Redwood Deep)

lines.name: Matriarch Aurelia
lines.text: Even the Dominion cannot fell that thing alone.
lines.where: Map feature: Raid Banner (Map 13 The Redwood Deep)

lines.name: High Marshal Shieldback
lines.text: Then we chip at it together. Every deck that fights wears it down.

lines.name: Matriarch Aurelia
lines.text: Will you stand with your enemies, if only for an afternoon?

lines.name: Matriarch Aurelia
lines.text: Then stand beside them and pretend. It works the same.
lines.label: never

lines.name: High Marshal Shieldback
lines.text: One shared foe. One shared prize when it falls.
lines.label: go

where: Map feature: Traveller’s Cart (Map 5 Gatorback Swamp)

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Ah! A customer. Or a soldier. In this war they're the same thing.
lines.where: Map feature: Traveller’s Cart (Map 5 Gatorback Swamp)

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Packs, trinkets, the odd rumour. Interested?

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Only that the Crown didn't fly away on its own. But you didn't hear it from me.
lines.label: rumour

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Leaves on the counter, please.
lines.label: go

where: Map feature: Ember Peddler (Map 8 Caves & Alcoves)

lines.name: Old Cinder, the Ember Peddler
lines.text: Mind the cinders. The Foundry's fire is right behind me, and it's still warm. So are the prices.
lines.where: Map feature: Ember Peddler (Map 8 Caves & Alcoves)

lines.name: Old Cinder, the Ember Peddler
lines.text: Tidemire Chests. Five cards, one you've never held. The Cart can't carry them this far up.

lines.name: Old Cinder, the Ember Peddler
lines.text: A mole who walked the wrong way out of a mine and kept going. You'll find my stall with the Cart's.
lines.label: who

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Competition! Wonderful. We'll share a counter. Shops, plural, now.
lines.label: go

where: Map feature: Gilded Caravan (Map 13 The Redwood Deep)

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: A caravan with gold on the wheels. They only sell the good cases.
lines.where: Map feature: Gilded Caravan (Map 13 The Redwood Deep)

lines.name: Captain Swiftpaw
lines.text: Highcrest Cases. I’ve heard of those.

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Look first. Buy second. Regret never.
lines.label: go

lines.text: A field guide to tricks. Every skill you have run into, and what beats it.

lines.text: It is a new page in your Codex: Skills.

where: Map feature: Stomping Grounds (Map 21 The Quiet Summit)

lines.text: Hoofprints, pawprints, clawprints. Everything that trains up here trains on this field.
lines.where: Map feature: Stomping Grounds (Map 21 The Quiet Summit)

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: The Stomping Grounds. Bring your Hero: level it, spend its points, pick its skills.

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Mind the ruts. Some of them are mine.
lines.label: go

where: Map feature: The Tavern (Map 14 Savanna Reaches)

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: A tavern, this far out. Warm fire, long tables, and a keeper who has heard every road story twice.
lines.where: Map feature: The Tavern (Map 14 Savanna Reaches)

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Rest here when you have earned it: every 20 different fights you clear, the keeper will stretch your stamina a little further.

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Max Energy, raised one cup at a time.
lines.label: go

where: Map feature: Test Lab (Map 21 The Quiet Summit)

lines.name: Whisper-of-Ash
lines.text: Psst. A tent full of tables. Nobody fights for real in here.
lines.where: Map feature: Test Lab (Map 21 The Quiet Summit)

lines.name: Whisper-of-Ash
lines.text: Put any cards down, see what they do. Nothing you win, nothing you lose.

lines.name: Whisper-of-Ash
lines.text: Experiments only. The Marshal calls it “cheating”. I call it homework.
lines.label: go

where: Map feature: Wanderer’s Camp (Map 13 The Redwood Deep)

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Someone made camp here. Someone who doesn’t stay anywhere long.
lines.where: Map feature: Wanderer’s Camp (Map 13 The Redwood Deep)

lines.name: Captain Swiftpaw
lines.text: The wandering trader! The one with the mystery boosters.

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Somewhere on the road, on some days. When you find them, they’ll sell you five. No more.
lines.label: go

where: Tapping the old well on Map 0  · arena_app.js:15932

lines.name: Captain Swiftpaw
lines.text: Huh. The old well. Otters drew water here long before the border war.
lines.where: Tapping the old well on Map 0  · arena_app.js:15932

lines.name: High Marshal Shieldback
lines.text: And hummingbirds drank from the bucket when nobody was looking. Nobody minded, back then.

lines.name: The Wandering Traveller
lines.text: Toss a leaf in, they say, and the Bramblewood remembers who was kind to it.
lines.replies: Toss in a leaf. | Keep walking.

lines.name: Captain Swiftpaw
lines.text: …Did it just splash back?
lines.label: toss

lines.name: High Marshal Shieldback
lines.text: Good. Superstition never won a skirmish.

lines.text: Wells are patient. So are the friends you make on both sides of the river.
